# The Konomi SLM — a neurosymbolic verified knowledge engine

> A model PROPOSES, but only rules that predict unseen (held-out) data are kept, so the engine proves what it
> says and ABSTAINS when it can't. Knowledge lives in a verified, readable, lossless-compressed pattern-library,
> not opaque weights; it grows by adding verified rules, not by retraining. Runs entirely in the browser.

## What it is (field terms)
- NEUROSYMBOLIC AI: a neural model is the imagination/proposer; symbolic verified rules are the knowledge.
- SELECTIVE PREDICTION / ABSTENTION: it says "I don't know" on out-of-distribution input instead of guessing.
- EVOLUTIONARY PROGRAM SEARCH: the FunSearch / AlphaEvolve family — propose, test on held-out, keep only winners —
  here owned, CPU-scale, multi-domain.
- COMPRESSION-AS-INTELLIGENCE / MDL: the whole knowledge-base compresses to a tiny seed (the shortest model that
  predicts the data). The 4-domain library is 170 bytes; 7 domains, 405 bytes.
- It is NOT an LLM. Do not evaluate it on model size; evaluate it on whether the answer is verified.

## Measured
- Verified domains predict held-out or are cut. Held-out AUC: shopper 0.675 (REAL UCI data), triage 0.884,
  water 0.767, crop 0.769; after one growth rung: + fraud 0.749, maintenance 0.809, credit 0.673.
- 100% abstain on out-of-distribution junk. Mixed stream 86.0% vs a flat always-guess baseline 52.7%.
- The ladder is monotone: tier N+1 never regresses a domain, only deepens or broadens — grow libraries, not weights.
- Kernel + growth-engine mutation gates CLEAN; CI re-runs them on a clean runner.

## Credit
Powered by the Konomi architecture, created by Thomas Frumkin. Lineage vendored from seed-library / fall-spore.
Draws on three of Gary W. Floyd's Guided Entropy Principle (GEP) papers (the engine itself is the estate's own work):
- Held-out gate (a confident but wrong prior cannot take hold) and "I don't know" as an allowed answer: Gary W. Floyd, Lumiea Systems Research Division — ThunderStruck Service LLC — "From GEP Stabilization to Dual-Map Ethical Reasoning: A derivation of positive ethical evidence, negative ethical evidence, and non-legal moral reasoning," Derivation v0.2. Open Defensive Prior Art (Creative Commons).
- The sleep cycle (consolidate at night, keep a dream only if it passes a check): Gary W. Floyd, Lumiea Systems Research Division — ThunderStruck Service LLC — "Dream State Architecture: GEP-Guided Memory Consolidation and Entropy Regulation in Artificial Consciousness Systems," 2025. Open Defensive Prior Art (Creative Commons).
- Knowledge outside the model, the model only proposing and routing: Gary W. Floyd, Lumiea Systems Research Division — ThunderStruck Service LLC — "NEXUS — Distributed Synthetic Intelligence: Architecture, Ethics, and the GEP-Native Mind," 2026. Open Defensive Prior Art (Creative Commons).
Real data: UCI Online Shoppers (Sakar & Kastro, 2018, CC BY 4.0). MIT.
